tables.name: public.users
tables.comment: Application accounts. Identity proof lives in auth_identities, not here.

columns.name: unit_system
columns.comment: Display preference only. All weights/distances are stored in metric.

columns.name: timezone
columns.comment: IANA name. Used to bucket workouts into local days for streaks and the heatmap.

indexes.name: users_pkey
indexes.def: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX users_pkey ON public.users USING btree (id)

indexes.name: users_email_key
indexes.def: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX users_email_key ON public.users USING btree (email)

indexes.name: users_username_key
indexes.def: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX users_username_key ON public.users USING btree (username)

triggers.name: users_set_updated_at
triggers.def: CREATE TRIGGER users_set_updated_at BEFORE UPDATE ON public.users FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION set_updated_at()

tables.name: public.auth_identities
tables.comment: One row per linked OAuth account. A user may link several providers.

columns.name: provider_subject
columns.comment: The provider's stable "sub" claim. Never key on email, which can change.

indexes.name: auth_identities_pkey
indexes.def: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX auth_identities_pkey ON public.auth_identities USING btree (id)

indexes.name: auth_identities_provider_provider_subject_key
indexes.def: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX auth_identities_provider_provider_subject_key ON public.auth_identities USING btree (provider, provider_subject)

indexes.name: auth_identities_user_id_idx
indexes.def: CREATE INDEX auth_identities_user_id_idx ON public.auth_identities USING btree (user_id)

constraints.name: auth_identities_user_id_fkey
constraints.def: FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

tables.name: public.refresh_tokens
tables.comment: Our own session tokens, issued after OAuth verification. Only a hash is stored.

columns.name: family_id
columns.comment: Shared by all tokens descended from one login. Reuse of a revoked token revokes the whole family.

indexes.name: refresh_tokens_pkey
indexes.def: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX refresh_tokens_pkey ON public.refresh_tokens USING btree (id)

indexes.name: refresh_tokens_token_hash_key
indexes.def: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX refresh_tokens_token_hash_key ON public.refresh_tokens USING btree (token_hash)

indexes.name: refresh_tokens_user_id_idx
indexes.def: CREATE INDEX refresh_tokens_user_id_idx ON public.refresh_tokens USING btree (user_id)

indexes.name: refresh_tokens_family_id_idx
indexes.def: CREATE INDEX refresh_tokens_family_id_idx ON public.refresh_tokens USING btree (family_id)

constraints.name: refresh_tokens_user_id_fkey
constraints.def: FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

tables.name: public.muscle_groups
tables.comment: Reference list of muscle groups (chest, lats, quads, ...).

indexes.name: muscle_groups_pkey
indexes.def: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX muscle_groups_pkey ON public.muscle_groups USING btree (id)

indexes.name: muscle_groups_slug_key
indexes.def: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX muscle_groups_slug_key ON public.muscle_groups USING btree (slug)

tables.name: public.exercises
tables.comment: Canonical exercises, e.g. "Lat Pulldown". Variations are tags, not separate exercises.

columns.name: status
columns.comment: official = curated catalog; user = private to created_by; pending_review = user exercise proposed for promotion.

columns.name: merged_into_id
columns.comment: Set when a duplicate is collapsed into another exercise. Readers follow the pointer; history is never rewritten.

indexes.name: exercises_pkey
indexes.def: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX exercises_pkey ON public.exercises USING btree (id)

indexes.name: exercises_slug_key
indexes.def: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX exercises_slug_key ON public.exercises USING btree (slug)

indexes.name: exercises_name_trgm_idx
indexes.def: CREATE INDEX exercises_name_trgm_idx ON public.exercises USING gin (name gin_trgm_ops)

indexes.name: exercises_created_by_idx
indexes.def: CREATE INDEX exercises_created_by_idx ON public.exercises USING btree (created_by)

indexes.name: exercises_merged_into_idx
indexes.def: CREATE INDEX exercises_merged_into_idx ON public.exercises USING btree (merged_into_id) WHERE (merged_into_id IS NOT NULL)

constraints.name: exercises_created_by_fkey
constraints.def: FOREIGN KEY (created_by) REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL

triggers.name: exercises_set_updated_at
triggers.def: CREATE TRIGGER exercises_set_updated_at BEFORE UPDATE ON public.exercises FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION set_updated_at()

tables.name: public.programs
tables.comment: A split, e.g. "Push / Pull / Legs". forked_from_id supports copying a friend's program later.

indexes.def: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX programs_pkey ON public.programs USING btree (id)
